decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's tube and system expertise and its early award signal gives management strong evidence that this related innovation can be learned from and commercialized further.
As a geothermal probe closely tied to the firm's established materials and application knowledge, it is within the firm's absorptive capacity even though later market evidence is limited.

This surface technology is related to the firm's existing materials and processing capabilities, so management is likely to retain it as an improvable adjacent offering despite sparse public performance signals.
A fire-protection steel profile system is very close to the firm's core building-system and steel competencies, making it a product the firm can understand, refine, and support effectively.

The slim steel profile system is near the established offer and fits the firm's customized construction solutions strategy, so management would usually continue it unless internal sales were clearly weak.

A decorative steel profile surface system remains closely connected to the firm's profile and surface know-how, which favors keeping it while leveraging existing production and customer relationships.
